samples.summary: Relocating `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` also loosened it, silently changing an out-of-diff consumer (`exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge`)
samples.evidence: The private version deleted from `text-editor.ts` required `pos.offset > start` (no zero-length run could ever match). The new shared `caret-style.ts` version drops that condition on purpose, for the Clear-formatting seed. But the function's *other* consumer is the pre-existing `TextEditor.exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge` (packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:5934), reached from four call sites the diff never touches — :981 (cursor/selection change), :2608 and :2641 (space / Enter insert), :4193. Those paths now fire on an empty-text `href` residue run (offset 0 == start == end) where they previously returned false, arming `pending` with `{...caretStyle, href: undefined}` in a case that was previously left alone. The effect looks benign (and is arguably the fix the new empty-paragraph test wants), but it is a behaviour change to four call sites whose reasoning is documented only for the Clear-formatting case; nothing in the diff or its tests exercises Enter/Space in the residue state. Fix belongs on the new function or on those call sites' coverage.

samples.summary: After dropping `href` from CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE, an `href` residue on a zero-length run is unreachable by every command
samples.evidence: `findLinkRunAt` refuses a zero-length inline by contract (packages/docs/src/view/link-run.ts:44 `inlines[i].text.length > 0`), so `EditorAPI.removeLink` (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:3742) and `TextBoxEditorAPI.removeLink`'s caret path (text-box-editor.ts:1274) both no-op on the residue `normalizeInlines` leaves when a linked paragraph's whole text is deleted. Clear formatting used to be the one write that reached it (`href: undefined` in the range payload); with `href` removed from `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE` no command in either editor can clear that stored attribute any more. The diff only fixes the *pending-style* consequence (typed characters), so the attribute still lives in the document/CRDT and any insertion path that does not consult pending style — a remote collaborator's insert, or a paste/insertText into that empty block — can re-materialise a hyperlink the user never created. Recoverable once the run has text (removeLink then works), hence minor rather than major.

samples.summary: Shared `removeLink` contract documents selection precedence, but only the slides text-box implements it; docs `EditorAPI.removeLink` stays caret-only
samples.evidence: The new shared doc on `TextFormattingEditor.removeLink` (packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/types.ts:95) says a selection takes precedence "where the implementation supports one". `packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:3737-3755` was not updated: it resolves the link purely from `cursor.position` via `findLinkRunAt`. So the two implementations behind one interface now differ, and the exact gesture the diff calls out as broken (drag over linked text past its end, then click Remove link) is still a silent no-op on the docs surface — currently masked only because docs never passes `showRemoveLink` and its popover opens on a caret. Any future surface that renders the shared button against the docs editor inherits the old bug.

samples.summary: Design doc still specifies the pre-change collapsed-caret contract for Clear formatting
samples.evidence: docs/design/docs/docs-pending-inline-style.md:128-130 still states `clearInlineFormatting()` does `pending.set(CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE, cursor.position)`. After this change the collapsed path goes through `pendingStyleFor` (view/editor.ts:1190) and may add `href: undefined`, and the keyboard half goes through `setPendingStyleGuarded`. `docs-font-controls.md` was updated for this; this nested doc was not, and nested design docs are not covered by the top-level backticked-path CI check, so nothing else will catch the drift.

samples.summary: Comments justify the new button by a "Board" surface that does not exist
samples.evidence: remove-link-button.test.ts:7 says the button is "the *only* way to drop one on the Slides and Board surfaces", and text-format-group.tsx:60-70 argues similarly. No Board surface consumes these components: `grep -n 'TextFormatGroup'` in packages/frontend/src matches only the slides toolbars and docs-formatting-toolbar, and `clearInlineFormatting|removeLink|getLinkAtCursor` has zero matches under packages/frontend/src/app/board and packages/board/src. Harmless today, but it is a rationale a future reader will act on.

finding.summary: Keyboard style toggles (Cmd+B/I/U/S) bypass the new `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` rule and re-arm the hyperlink the change deliberately stops growing
finding.evidence: The diff establishes (caret-style.ts doc comment: "every caller that stores a caret-derived style has to ask this before doing so, or typing silently extends the link") and enforces the rule in two places: `editor.ts:1203` via `pendingStyleFor` and `text-editor.ts:3443` in `clearFormatting`. `TextEditor.toggleStyle` — the keyboard half of Bold/Italic/Underline/Strikethrough — still seeds pending straight from the caret style at `packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:3497`: `this.pending?.set({ ...visual, ...resolved }, this.cursor.position)` where `visual = { ...this.getStyleAtCursor(), ...pending }`. At a link trailing edge `getStyleAtCursor()` carries the run's `href`, and `exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge` is only invoked on space/Enter/paste (text-editor.ts:981, 2608, 2641, 4171), never on caret placement or after `insertLink` — the very scenario the new test `a toolbar toggle at a link trailing edge does not re-arm the link` covers for the toolbar path. Cmd+B at the same spot then typing a plain character still extends the hyperlink. The fix belongs on this out-of-diff line (route it through the same `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` check).

verdict.reason: The claimed bypass line does not exist and the keyboard path is in fact routed through the guard. `text-editor.ts:3497` is `const effectiveVisual = { ...this.styleDefaultsAtCursor(), ...visual };`, not a raw `pending.set`. The collapsed-caret branch of `toggleStyle` (text-editor.ts:3513-3521) writes through `this.setPendingStyleGuarded({ ...visual, ...resolved })` at text-editor.ts:3519. `setPendingStyleGuarded` (text-editor.ts:3465-3474) evaluates `isAtLinkTrailingEdge(this.doc, this.cursor.position)` at 3468 (or an already-armed `href: undefined` in pending at 3469) and forces `href: undefined` into the seed at 3471 before calling `pending.set`, which also handles the replace-not-merge hazard. All Cmd+B/I/U/S entry points go through `toggleStyle` (text-editor.ts:1187, 1193, 1199, 1205). An exhaustive grep for `pending.set` across packages/docs/src finds only four write sites, and all four are guarded: text-editor.ts:3470 (guarded), text-editor.ts:5938 (gated by `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` at 5935), editor.ts:1203 (via `pendingStyleFor`, guard at 1195), and text-box-editor.ts:899 (guard at 897). So the keyboard half agrees with the toolbar half on the same shared rule; there is no bypass.

finding.summary: Slides text-box collapsed-caret font-size step seeds pending with the caret's `href`, bypassing the new trailing-edge guard on the one surface that has no link popover
finding.evidence: `stepSelectionFontSizeImpl`'s collapsed branch does `const base = { ...caretStyle(false), ...staged }; pending.set({ ...base, fontSize: next }, cursor.position)` (packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:881-888). `caretStyle(false)` is `caretInlineStyle(doc, cursor.position, false)`, which at a link's trailing edge reports the link run's `href`, so the next typed character extends the hyperlink. The docs equivalent routes through `applyStyleImpl` → the new `pendingStyleFor` (editor.ts:1306-1317, 1194-1200) and is covered by the new test `stepping the font size at a link trailing edge does not re-arm the link`; the text-box copy has no such guard and this diff did not add one.

verdict.reason: The claimed unguarded code is not in the file. `stepSelectionFontSizeImpl`'s collapsed-caret branch in packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:895-902 does NOT do `pending.set({ ...base, fontSize: next }, cursor.position)`; it builds `seed`, computes `const exitsLink = isAtLinkTrailingEdge(doc, cursor.position) || ('href' in staged && staged.href === undefined)`, and calls `pending.set(exitsLink ? { ...seed, href: undefined } : seed, cursor.position)`. That is the same trailing-edge guard as the docs editor's `pendingStyleFor` (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1190-1198), off the same shared helper `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` (packages/docs/src/model/caret-style.ts:80), imported at text-box-editor.ts:38, and it also carries the already-armed `href: undefined` case. The function's other branch (text-box-editor.ts:908-938) writes only `fontSize` through `docStore.applyStyles` and never seeds pending, so no href can be re-armed there. There is therefore no bypassing site at the cited location.
